title: Add FFmpeg media policy regression matrix fixture
summary: Add a machine-readable FFmpeg/media-policy regression matrix fixture, a unittest guard for row completeness and planner expectations, and documentation links for TESTGAP-006 validation gating.
reason: Future FFmpeg/media-policy work needs an auditable matrix where every row names expected behavior, owner code paths, automated checks, and the validation rung before anyone treats TESTGAP-006 as closable.
behavior_before: Media-policy parity expectations were spread across existing planner tests, Tdarr tooling notes, real-media playbooks, and audit documents, with no single machine-readable row matrix enforcing expected outcome, owner path, automated check, and validation rung metadata.
behavior_after: The new fixture records remux, encode, subtitle, audio, size, stream mapping, sidecar, pending-publish, and failure-mode rows; the new integration test validates matrix completeness, Python planner rows, size-policy rows, and TESTGAP-006 closure prerequisites without changing media behavior.
manual_validation: apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.python.integration.test_ffmpeg_media_policy_regression_matrix -q - red check failed before fixture existed, then passed after fixture addition

apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -m unittest tests.python.tooling.test_summary_integrity -q - passed 13 tests; reported existing orphan summary docs/generated/summaries/src/mediapipeline/core/deleted.py.md
rollback_plan: Remove the FFmpeg media-policy matrix fixture, its integration test, the testing doc, and the DOCS_INDEX/TEST_SUITE inventory links; then refresh summaries and rerun the integration matrix tests.
notes: Validation metadata and tests only. No FFmpeg command generation, subtitle conversion, audio routing, publish/drain, source/scratch/output movement, queue execution, or WebView mutation behavior changed. TESTGAP-006 remains open until Python/PowerShell parity coverage and required representative real-media evidence exist.
